scope: Quick idle comparison; frontlight off, Wi-Fi on; no page turns; installed binary
comparison: Rough idle estimate; about one minute per app, not a reading/page-turn benchmark
wireless: Wi-Fi connected; SSH disconnected during each capture
driver_quirk: Ricoh619 vendor current_now returns remaining charge in mAh; recorder converts this to charge_now in uAh
limitations: Whole-device consumption, including Wi-Fi and sampler overhead.
One mAh gauge steps give coarse estimates in such short captures.
Different static screens; no controlled page-turn workload.
